title: UAAP: La Salle sweeps UP, takes early lead in men's chess
summary: De La Salle University scored a 4-0 sweep of University of the Philippines to open its UAAP Season 89 Men's Chess Championships campaign on Saturday at the BGPOP Building, UST in Manila City.
